task.instruction: Let g(x) be the integral of x^2 cos(2x). Write the expression of g(x).

final_answer:
g(x) = ∫ x² cos(2x) dx = (x²/2) sin(2x) + (x/2) cos(2x) − (1/4) sin(2x) + C.

Equivalently, g(x) = ½x² sin(2x) + ½x cos(2x) − ¼ sin(2x) + C.
